basis.governing_question: Why do property and health claims take too long to settle, and what claims operating model should Atlântico Seguros move to?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish where time is lost in settling property and health claims today and what causes it.

gate.label: Diagnostic readout
gate.decision: Confirm the current-state findings and the improvement areas to take into design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the claims operating model Atlântico Seguros should move to and prepare the recommendation for the Board.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the recommended claims operating model and roadmap for the Board?

workstreams.name: Performance baseline
workstreams.answers: How long do property and health claims take to settle, where is time lost, and how satisfied are customers?
activities: Map the steps from claim notification to settlement
Analyze operational data on handling times by claim type
Collect customer satisfaction results for both claim types

workstreams.name: Causes of delay
workstreams.answers: What do the people who handle claims say causes the delays, and what did the 2024 lean program leave untouched?
activities: Interview claims handlers and the people who do the work
Interview the COO and Head of Claims on delay causes
Review claims procedures and 2024 lean program documents

workstreams.name: Improvement priorities
workstreams.answers: Which causes of delay matter most for settlement time, and which can change without lowering satisfaction?
activities: Quantify how much each cause adds to settlement time
Test each cause against the satisfaction baseline
Rank improvement areas against both success criteria

workstreams.name: Target model options
workstreams.answers: Which claims operating models could cut settlement time while keeping customer satisfaction at current levels?
activities: Draft claims operating model options from the findings
Compare options on settlement time and satisfaction
Test options with the COO and Head of Claims

workstreams.name: Detailed model design
workstreams.answers: How would the chosen model work in daily claims handling for property and health claims?
activities: Specify roles, process flow and governance of the model
Check the design against claims handling data
Review the design with claims handlers

workstreams.name: Recommendation and roadmap
workstreams.answers: What should Atlântico Seguros do to move to the model, and how does it meet both success criteria?
activities: Build the roadmap to move to the recommended model
Test the recommendation against both success criteria
Draft the written report and Board presentation

deliverables.name: Claims process map for property and health claims
Option effect on settlement time and satisfaction
Detailed design of the chosen claims model
Written report and Board presentation on the claims model

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align scope, plan and access to data
events.decision: Confirm the scope and plan for the diagnostic?
agenda: Present the engagement plan and timeline
Align on access to claims data and interviewees
Confirm how the COO and Head of Claims will steer

events.label: Workshop 1: first findings
events.purpose: Review first findings and delay causes
events.decision: Confirm the first findings and the focus for the rest of the diagnostic?
agenda: Present the process map and the settlement and satisfaction baseline
Review the interview synthesis of delay causes
Discuss where to focus the remaining analysis

events.label: Diagnostic readout
events.decision: Confirm the current-state findings and the improvement areas to take into design?
agenda: Review the diagnostic readout of current-state findings
Decide which improvement areas go into design

events.label: Workshop 2: model options
events.purpose: Compare model options and choose one
events.decision: Which claims operating model option goes into detailed design?
agenda: Present the claims operating model options
Review the effect of each option on both success criteria

events.label: Final readout
events.decision: Approve the recommended claims operating model and roadmap for the Board?
agenda: Present the written report and the Board presentation
Review the detailed design and the roadmap
Confirm the recommendation against both success criteria

deadline.text: Recommendations presented to the Board on March 15, 2027

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given: the 6-8 and 8-10 week phases are my estimate from the archetype, within the 19 weeks available.
Not covered by the phases: ASF, supervisor issued new guidance on claims-handling response times for non-life insurers. Confirm whether it is in scope.
